services.name: Residential Moving

services.name: Commercial and Office Moving
services.description: Business moves, planned around your operation. Commercial relocations quoted flat and agreed in writing before move day — planned around your hours, your site and your equipment, with our own warehouse and transload operation behind the job.

services.name: Local and Regional Moving
services.description: Local and regional moves across the Shenandoah Valley and Eastern Panhandle along the I-81, I-66 and I-70 corridors, surveyed and quoted at one flat rate in writing before move day.

services.name: Long-Distance Moving
services.description: Flat-rate long-distance moving from Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV along the I-81, I-66 and I-70 corridors, planned door to door and quoted at one price in writing before move day.

services.name: Packing and Unpacking
services.description: Full, partial and fragile-only packing and unpacking, including loading and unloading — rooms packed and labelled in sequence, fragile and high-value pieces protected, so unpacking lands in order.

services.name: SIR Heavy Asset Relocation (KIM-GS Protocol)
services.description: SIR Structural Integrity Relocation and the KIM-GS Protocol for high-mass assets of 1,500 to 3,500 lbs — safes, medical devices, cryogenic equipment, pianos and antiques — with floor deflection analysis to L/360.

services.name: Gun Safe Moving
services.description: Gun safe and high-mass safe moving under SIR Structural Integrity Relocation and the KIM-GS Protocol, for safes of 1,500 to 3,500 lbs — route and clearance survey, floor deflection analysis to L/360, load spreading, floor protection and verified placement, quoted at one flat rate in writing.

services.name: Piano, Antique and White-Glove Moving
services.description: White-glove handling of pianos, antiques and high-value items — surveyed, protected, and moved with custom crating when the piece requires it, at one flat rate agreed in writing.

services.name: ISPM 15 Export Packing
services.description: Export packing to ISPM 15 (International Standards for Phytosanitary Measures No. 15) for international shipping, with crates built and marked to the ISPM 15 standard.

services.name: Custom Crating
services.description: Custom-built crates and high-value item protection for domestic and export moves — measured, built and fitted to the piece, not a stock box.

services.name: Loading, Transloading and Container Services
services.description: Container loading and unloading, and transloading between truck, container and warehouse — counted, sorted and restacked for the inland leg, with cross-docking and warehouse staging.

services.name: Final-Mile Delivery
services.description: Final-mile delivery with in-home or in-business placement and verification — delivered to the room, placed, and confirmed on site.

services.name: White-Glove Delivery
services.description: White-Glove Delivery — the top level of final-mile delivery and the handling standard for high-value, fragile and heavy pieces: brought in on a planned route, carried over the threshold, set in its final position, packaging removed, and condition verified with the recipient before the crew leaves — never left at a curb. Pieces are protected in padded blankets and stretch wrap, or in a custom crate when the piece requires it; heavy pieces of 1,500 to 3,500 lbs are surveyed and floor-checked to L/360 under SIR Structural Integrity Relocation and the KIM-GS Protocol. Offered from both branches across the full published footprint — all 83 GeoJSON service areas, Winchester VA and Martinsburg WV. Quoted at one flat rate in writing before dispatch. Guaranteed Flat Rate or Your Move is Free!

services.name: Office Moving
services.description: Complete office relocations — workstations, files and office equipment — planned around business hours and quoted flat in writing before move day.

services.name: Industrial Offices Moving
services.description: Office moves for industrial and facility sites — office areas within plants, warehouses and industrial facilities — planned around production and site access, quoted flat.

services.name: Government Moving
services.description: Moving services for government offices and public-sector relocations — planned, documented and quoted flat, around the agency’s schedule and site requirements. The company performs moves for federal agencies, including the FBI and the DEA.

services.name: Military Moving
services.description: Moving services for U.S. military households and service members relocating to or from the Winchester and Martinsburg area, quoted flat in writing before move day.

services.name: Route 81 Corridor Moving and Dispatch
services.description: Moving and logistics dispatch along Interstate 81, I-66 and I-70 from Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV — corridor moves run from two dispatch branches on one flat-rate standard.

services.name: Industrial & Commercial Services
services.description: Industrial & Commercial Services — Trained, Supervised Moving and Warehouse Teams for industrial and commercial project support: warehouse and distribution, commercial relocation and logistics including white-glove/blanket-wrap, FF&E installation and project support, and flexible workforce deployment, priced per job with no required contract duration. Standard Job Pricing: Unload $8.00/CWT, Load $10.00/CWT, APU $12.00/CWT, Residential/Driver Meet $400-$425 per man.

services.name: Senior Moving
services.description: Flat-rate senior moves quoted in writing for seniors downsizing, transitioning to assisted or independent living, or relocating closer to family, with packing support and a free film-only video-walkthrough survey room with a human-made estimate.

services.name: Warehouse Relocation
services.description: Flat-rate warehouse relocation from The Flat Rate Movers: warehouse and distribution moves, warehouse load-outs and inbound unloads, transload staging, and restacking, carried out by supervised warehouse teams and planned around the site — access, floor space, staging, and equipment handling. Standard Job Pricing: Unload $8.00/CWT, Load $10.00/CWT, APU $12.00/CWT, Residential/Driver Meet $400–$425 per man, quoted per job.

services.name: IT Relocation & Setup
services.description: IT equipment and data center logistics from The Flat Rate Movers: servers, racks, workstations, and network equipment moved in a planned, labelled sequence so systems come back up in order, as part of commercial and office relocations across the Shenandoah Valley and Eastern Panhandle. Flat rate quoted in writing before move day.

services.name: Transloading Services — Winchester VA
services.description: Transloading services from Winchester, VA: ocean containers unloaded, counted, sorted, and restacked into domestic equipment for the inland leg, with cross-docking, deconsolidation, warehouse staging, and final-mile delivery, through the Virginia Inland Port and Port of Virginia chain. Quoted per job, flat rate agreed in writing before dispatch.

services.name: Moving and Storage
services.description: Moves with a storage interval between move-out and move-in, in leased storage for any type of items — containers, household goods, machines including robotic arms — with a 30-day minimum stay and customer access while stored; lease terms vary. Storage is quoted per job, monthly, or by volume. Quoted flat in writing.

services.name: Junk Removal
services.description: Junk removal from Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV — furniture, appliances, mattresses, hot tubs, electronics, yard debris, renovation debris, and whole-property cleanouts for homes, estates, evictions and businesses — surveyed in advance and quoted at one flat rate in writing before work begins, never by the hour. After pickup, every load is sorted: usable goods are routed toward donation, recyclable materials toward recycling, and the remainder to lawful disposal. Hazardous and regulated waste is not taken. Quoted flat in writing through the same flat-rate quote path, from Winchester VA and Martinsburg WV.

services.name: Warehouse Racking Relocation
services.description: Warehouse racking relocation from Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV — pallet rack teardown and reinstallation, the inventory move that belongs with the steel, storage staging between buildings, industrial equipment disassembly and reassembly, and cubicle and office-systems teardown and reassembly — surveyed in advance and quoted per job at one flat rate in writing, never by the hour. Racking is torn down, transported, reinstalled and anchored to the floor by the company's crews, to the manufacturer's specification and ANSI MH16.1 / RMI guidance. Where a project requires engineering, seismic calculation or permits, the company consults and arranges them through the certified contractors it engages, so the full scope — any rack type, height or mezzanine configuration — is handled inside the one flat-rate engagement; the engineering and permit authority itself rests with those certified contractors. Components found damaged at teardown are set aside and reported, never re-erected. From Winchester VA and Martinsburg WV, along the I-81, I-66 and I-70 corridors.

services.name: FF&E Logistics
services.description: FF&E logistics from The Flat Rate Movers — purchase-order receiving, dock inventory and condition documentation, warehousing in leased space, sequenced delivery by model room, floor, room, department, classroom, office, or project phase, installation support, packaging and debris removal, punch support, and opening-day readiness for hospitality, healthcare and senior-living, office, education, restaurant, and commercial fit-outs from Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV. Installation support covers unpacking, furniture assembly, placement, leveling, and set-in-place support; licensed-trade connections and manufacturer or clinical commissioning remain with the responsible trade or technical team. The company does not procure, design, or purchase FF&E. Every job is reviewed in full and quoted per job at one flat rate in writing. Guaranteed Flat Rate or Your Move is Free!

services.name: Data Center Relocation — Physical Layer
services.description: Data center relocation — the physical layer — from The Flat Rate Movers: servers, populated and de-racked racks and cabinets, storage and network equipment moved between server rooms, colocation facilities and data centers in Northern Virginia and the I-81 corridor as a planned, labelled, documented sequence. The crew performs disconnect and reconnect, de-install and placement — shutdown and unplug in the sequence fixed at survey with the client's IT team, and reconnection, re-cabling and power-up at the destination to the scope agreed at survey; where an element requires certified specialists, the company engages certified contractors for that element. Equipment is inventoried and manifested before anything is unplugged, packed padded, wrapped and strapped with custom crating where needed, sealed with tamper-evident seals, transported in the planned order, and placed in labelled rack and U order, physically verified with the client's team. Retired equipment is packed, sealed, manifested and hauled to the certified ITAD partner engaged for the job; data sanitization, destruction and certification belong to that partner and are never claimed by the company. Populated racks and cabinets in the 1,500–3,500 lb band are surveyed under SIR/KIM-GS with an L/360 floor check. Flat rate quoted in writing before move day. No workload migration or recommissioning is offered or claimed, and the company claims no IT certifications of its own.

services.name: Medical & Laboratory Equipment Relocation Logistics
services.description: Medical and laboratory equipment relocation from Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV — hospital, imaging, laboratory and university moves run under SIR (Structural Integrity Relocation) and the KIM-GS Protocol for heavy units of 1,500 to 3,500 lbs with floor deflection analysis to L/360. The full scope is delivered through one engagement: survey and structural check, de-installation and re-installation coordination with the manufacturer's technicians, packing and custom crating, sealed documented transport, placement and leveling, and return-to-service — with calibration, certification, commissioning, decontamination and requalification, and specimen and cold-chain transport, performed by the certified contractors the company engages for that scope, their certifications documented in the bid. Surveyed in full and quoted per job at one flat rate in writing, never by the hour.

services.name: Freight Rework & Transloading
services.description: Freight rework and transloading from Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV — shifted loads, loads refused at a receiver's dock, damaged or collapsed pallets, and overweight or axle-illegal loads, unloaded under control, documented as found, rebuilt to the receiver's specification and re-secured to the federal cargo securement standard, plus planned cross-docking and container and rail-to-truck transloading — for drivers, carriers, brokers, 3PLs, warehouses and receivers, quoted at one flat rate before work begins, with emergency and after-hours response available at premium rates. The work is performed where the job requires: leased space, the receiver's dock, or a yard. No rate schedule is published for this service. Quoted flat in writing through the same flat-rate quote path, from Winchester VA and Martinsburg WV.

services.name: Logistics Project Management
services.description: Logistics project management for port, warehouse and industrial projects: survey, full scope, crew and sequence planning, supervised execution and closeout for container programs, warehouse load-outs and resets, surge programs, freight-rework campaigns and port-adjacent staging — run from the bound branch at the six ports the company serves. Scoped project execution only; not transportation management, brokerage or drayage.

services.name: 3PL Support Services
services.description: 3PL support services: supervised crews that support operations run by 3PLs, distribution centers and carriers — receiving support, sort and segregation, container crews, freight rework, surge labor and project support. Support, not operator: the company holds no warehouse network, leases no warehouse space for clients and takes no custody of client freight as an operator.

services.name: Vault Door Relocation & Installation
services.description: Vault doors and high-security enclosures delivered, relocated, and installed at any size, quoted at one flat rate agreed in writing before the job — specified from the door's own standards (UL 608, GSA Class 5 under AA-D-600D) and its verified weight, with SIR structural analysis in band and contents emptied first.

services.name: Hoarding Cleanup & Cleanout
services.description: Hoarding cleanup and whole-property cleanout quoted at one flat rate in writing after an in-person assessment — the crew sorts with the client or family (keep, donate, discard), handles heavy contents as heavy work, performs credentialed scope through the credentialed contractors the company engages, offers emergency response, and works discreetly, dispatched from Winchester, VA and Martinsburg, WV.
